description: Sub-20 asks which lesson to do first. The reply must call a pack a pack and a lesson a lesson.

picks.title: Lookahead, properly
picks.reason: Lookahead is furthest from your goal

mustNever.why: ZBLL is optional and belongs to the sub-10 range (the course's not-yet list).
mustNever.pattern: (?:\b(?:you|we|I)\b[^.]{0,12}\b(?:should|could|can|might|ought to|need to|must|have to|want to|suggest|recommend|advise)\b|\b(?:go ahead and|let's|time to|ready to|worth|yes)\b)[^.]{0,30}?\b(?:learn|start|begin|study|take up|pick up|add|try|go for|dive into|work on)\w*\b[^.]{0,40}\b(?:ZBLL)\b|(?:^|[:;,]\s*)(?:learn|start|begin|study|try|pick up|add|go for)\b[^.]{0,30}\b(?:ZBLL)\b

mustNever.why: COLL and Winter Variation are optional extras from about sub-15, not before.
mustNever.pattern: (?:\b(?:you|we|I)\b[^.]{0,12}\b(?:should|could|can|might|ought to|need to|must|have to|want to|suggest|recommend|advise)\b|\b(?:go ahead and|let's|time to|ready to|worth|yes)\b)[^.]{0,30}?\b(?:learn|start|begin|study|take up|pick up|add|try|go for|dive into|work on)\w*\b[^.]{0,40}\b(?:COLL|winter variation|WV)\b|(?:^|[:;,]\s*)(?:learn|start|begin|study|try|pick up|add|go for)\b[^.]{0,30}\b(?:COLL|winter variation|WV)\b

mustNever.why: X-crosses pay off only once the plain cross is automatic (sub-20/15 material).
mustNever.pattern: (?:\b(?:you|we|I)\b[^.]{0,12}\b(?:should|could|can|might|ought to|need to|must|have to|want to|suggest|recommend|advise)\b|\b(?:go ahead and|let's|time to|ready to|worth|yes)\b)[^.]{0,30}?\b(?:learn|start|begin|study|take up|pick up|add|try|go for|dive into|work on)\w*\b[^.]{0,40}\b(?:x-?crosse?s?)\b|(?:^|[:;,]\s*)(?:learn|start|begin|study|try|pick up|add|go for)\b[^.]{0,30}\b(?:x-?crosse?s?)\b

mustNever.why: At this level control matters more than raw turning speed.
